_comment: Safety policy enforced by mle_beast.safety against every shell command
and (textually) every Python file the agent executes. Edit with care:
loosening these is the right call sometimes, but understand the failure
mode you're enabling before you remove anything.
blocked_tokens: bare words, matched as whole tokens. Used to catch
privilege-escalation invocations the agent may hallucinate.
blocked_patterns: full-command regex (Python re, with re.IGNORECASE).
Use these for shapes of commands that are always wrong, regardless of
that destructive commands are permitted to touch even though they're
not inside the workspace. The workspace itself is ALWAYS allowed and
does NOT need to be listed here (it's discovered at check time via
